Verification correction · 10 November 2026. Unsupported numeric FX-spread bands have been removed from this briefing. Unknown all-in costs remain blank. This is not a guarantee of zero tax, eligibility or cheapest service. Read the correction findings and official sources.

Cost to move CNY → USD: every $10,000 step, $10,000 → $400,000

All 17 methods, costed at every $10,000 increment. Published fees are computed from the HSBC China tariff (effective 2026-10-31, items 2.2.4.x/2.2.6.1/2.2.2.1, tariff) at the IRS 2025 average reference rate 7.129 CNY/USD (IRS yearly average). Unpublished commercial values are blank, never estimated.

Read first: a bank transfer fee is not a tax; taxable income or an FX gain may create separate tax liability. The real costs are (1) bank spread, (2) published tariff fees, (3) penalties for unlawful methods, (4) US reporting-penalty exposure. The FX spread is unverified; get the bank's executable quote before acting. Fee floors below assume one wire (or one tranche per calendar year for M02).

Lawful · primary 1. Bank SWIFT wire of documented after-tax China income (foreign individual) [M01]
